title: Log Cake
description: A decadent no-bake chocolate log made with butter, dark chocolate and digestive biscuits. Rich, indulgent and perfect for a special occasion.
steps: Grease and line a standard loaf tin.
Melt the butter and chocolate together in a heatproof bowl in the microwave in 20-second bursts, or over a saucepan of boiling water. Mix with a wooden spoon.
Put half the digestives in a bag and bash into crumbs. Add to the chocolate mixture and mix thoroughly.
Crumble the other half into the mixture keeping the chunks big. Mix, then transfer to the loaf tin, packing tightly into all the corners and levelling the top.
Refrigerate for an hour to set, then turn out on to a board and slice into thick pieces.
notes: Slices into 8–10 pieces. Keeps in the fridge for a week. Can use Hobnobs or different chocolate.
